column1: # REGISTER 4, PARTIAL — mutation-proofs.partial-code.tsv   CODE WAVE, filled BY EXECUTION
# Companion to `mutation-proofs.tsv`, which is FROZEN at 61 rows (one per guard file) with
# `mutation`/`decoy`/`observed` deliberately empty. This file does not touch that one. It carries
# the proofs for the guard ROWS this wave added INSIDE three existing guard files — the freeze
# forbids adding a guard file, so criteria G1 and G2 were shipped as new rows in
# `test_render.py`, `test_graph_demo.py` and `test_scale_contract.py` rather than as new files.
# The unit here is therefore the ROW (a test function), not the file.
# EVERY CELL BELOW WAS RECORDED FROM EXECUTION, NOT PREDICTED. Each mutation was applied to the
# working tree, the single named test was run, the tree was restored from a byte copy, and
# `git diff` was checked empty for the mutated file afterwards. `observed` quotes the first
# WHY EVERY ROW CARRIES A DECOY. A mutation that turns a guard red proves only that the guard is
# sensitive to something. The decoy is an edit in the SAME neighbourhood that does not introduce
# the defect class — a refactor, a rewording, a legitimate retuning — and it must stay green. A
# row with a mutation and no decoy is a claim about a guard, not a measurement of one.
#   guard rows added by this wave ...................... 17 test functions in 3 guard files,
#                                                         they are that row's mutation/decoy set)
#   file-level mutations applied, run and restored ..... 17  (16 defect mutations + 1 second
#   decoys applied, run and restored ................... 17  (16 + 1 extra near-miss decoy)
#   in-file fixture oracles (the analyser row) ......... 15  (6 must-flag + 9 must-not-flag)
#   mutations that turned their row red ................ 17 of 17
#   decoys that left their row green ................... 17 of 17
# One near-miss is recorded rather than hidden: the FIRST mutation drafted for
# GREEN, and correctly — that edit still READS the parameter, so it is not the defect class. It
# was re-drafted to actually stop reading it. The failed draft is kept as an extra decoy because
# it is the closest thing to a false positive this guard could have had.
# FREEZE RULE: this file may grow only while this wave runs; anything found after it closes goes
